question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 4% per month for 2 months.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total interest percentage for 2 months at 4% per month = 4% × 2 = 8%.

Simple Interest = 8% of the Principal.

⇒ SI = (8 ÷ 100) × 1200

⇒ SI = 8 × 12 = 96

**∴ The correct answer is ₹96.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1200

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per month

Time (T) = 2 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
• 
 
 
 Month 0
 P = ₹1200

 
 Month 1
 + ₹48 (4%)
 
 
 Month 2
 + ₹48 (4%)

 

 

 4% interest
 4% interest

 
 Total SI = ₹96

**Calculations:**

⇒ Since both the interest rate and time are given in months, we do not need to convert time to years.

⇒ SI = (1200 × 4 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (1200 × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 12 × 8

⇒ SI = 96

**∴ The correct answer is ₹96.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Alignment of Rate and Time

Before applying the simple interest formula, always ensure that the rate of interest and time period share the same units (e.g., both per annum, or both per month). If the rate is per annum and time is in months, convert time by using T = months ÷ 12.

Effective Interest Method

The total effective interest percentage over a given timeframe is simply Rate × Time. For example, 4% per month for 2 months yields an overall interest equal to 8% of the principal amount.

Simple vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is strictly computed on the initial principal sum over the whole tenure. Compound Interest is computed on the principal as well as any previously accumulated interest. CI formula: A = P(1 + R/100)T.
